app_intro: A personal workspace for exploring document search and AI chat. This is the project skeleton — the two panels below mark where the document library and the chat will live.
knowledge_base_subtitle: Upload Markdown documents and follow them through indexing.
knowledge_base_empty: No documents yet. Upload a Markdown file to get started.
knowledge_base_limits: Markdown only, up to {maxMb} MB per file and {maxFiles} files per upload. The library holds up to {maxLibrary} documents.
documents_error_batch: {name}: no more than {maxFiles} files per upload.
documents_list_error: The document list could not be loaded.
documents_delete_description: The document, its index and its vectors are removed. This cannot be undone.
documents_delete_processing_warning: Indexing is still running for this document; it is stopped and cleaned up.
chat_subtitle: Ask a question about your documents. Every answer cites the passages it is based on.
chat_model_disclaimer: Answers are generated by {model}: it can attach a sentence to the wrong passage, so open a citation to check it against the original.
chat_history_disclaimer: We do not store chat history. It stays in this browser tab and is gone when you leave the page.
chat_empty: Questions and answers with their sources will appear here.
chat_error: The answer could not be generated.
chat_context_error: The passage could not be loaded.
chat_error_too_long: The question is too long — up to {max} characters.
chat_legend_unsupported: Dashed underline: a sentence with no citation.
chat_quote_unverified: A quotation attributed to this source was not found in it.
chat_flag_unknown_markers: a citation marker matching no source
chat_flag_leaked_markup: evidence formatting copied into the answer
landing_hero_subheading: Upload Markdown files and ask questions in plain language. Every answer cites the exact passage it came from, so you can verify it in one click.
landing_mobile_nav_description: Jump to the knowledge base, chat, or docs.
landing_usecases_grounded_description: Every response is built from retrieved passages, not memory — open the citation to see the source line.
landing_usecases_grounded_question: What does the refund policy say about digital goods?
landing_usecases_grounded_answer: Digital goods are non-refundable after download, per section 4.2.
landing_usecases_ingestion_description: Follow a document from upload through chunking to ready — the same states the pipeline itself uses.
landing_usecases_ingestion_log_failed: Failed to process — retry from the document list
landing_usecases_pipeline_description: One pipeline, one AWS account: chunk, embed, retrieve, rerank, answer.
landing_features_hybrid_description: Every question runs a vector search and a BM25 keyword search in parallel, merged by reciprocal rank fusion — an exact ID or date is never lost to the embedding.
landing_features_rerank_description: The fused candidates go through Cohere Rerank 3.5 — only passages above the relevance floor ever reach the model.
landing_features_citations_description: Every claim carries a marker back to its source — open one and jump straight to the cited lines in the original file.
landing_features_verified_description: Quotes are verified against the source, every marker is resolved, and a sentence with no citation is flagged — automatically, after the answer is generated.
landing_features_abstain_description: No passage clears the relevance bar, and the model is never called — the app abstains instead of guessing.
landing_features_serverless_description: Three Lambda functions, two S3 buckets, no database — a pipeline that scales to zero and costs only what you use.
landing_cta_banner_heading: Ready to ask your first question?
